description: This file contains the implementation of a CMS image file manager using Infinispan cache for storing, retrieving, and removing product images, especially for different product sizes. It manages product images in a hierarchical cache structure, keyed by merchant code and product SKU, and supports operations like add, get, and remove images.

classes.name: CmsImageFileManagerInfinispanImpl
classes.description: Implementation of image file management using Infinispan cache; manages product images for different sizes and provides CRUD operations.

methods.name: stopFileManager
methods.description: Stops the cache manager, used during servlet un-deployments to properly shut down caching.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Stores a product image into the cache under the merchant and product hierarchy, categorized by size.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image based on merchant code, product SKU, or product image details.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves all images associated with a merchant store or a product.

methods.name: removeImages
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes all images for a specific product.

methods.name: getProductImage (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves specific-sized images for a product, with default small size.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image with specified size.
